_comment: MEA Pipeline Config. CLI flags always override these values. Remove _comment keys before use.

io._comment: Set output_dir for all results. checkpoint_dir defaults to <output_dir>/checkpoints if not set.

sorting._comment: sorter options: kilosort4, mountainsort5, tridesclous. docker_image only needed for containerized sorting. kilosort_params overrides the built-in VRAM-tier defaults: those two tiers differ in dmin, cluster_downsampling and max_cluster_subset, which change the sorting result, so pin them here for any dataset processed on more than one GPU model. The values actually used are written to sorting_params.json in each well folder.

burst_detection._comment: burst_detector: parameter_free (default, adaptive fragment/network-burst/superburst hierarchy) | gaussian (literature-standard Gaussian population-rate detector, network_bursts tier only, no merging). gaussian_* fields apply only to the gaussian detector, parameter_free_* only to the parameter_free one. gaussian_min_prominence: null derives it from the signal (its SD, per-unit Hz). gaussian_min_height_sd: peak height gate at mean + N*SD of the smoothed rate; set 0 to disable it and reproduce the MATLAB ThresholdMethod='Adaptive' code as shipped, which applies no height gate and therefore reports bursts even in silent wells. gaussian_onset_offset_peak_frac: burst edges where the rate falls below peak * this fraction, so smaller means longer bursts. parameter_free_min_superburst_components: 2 makes a superburst a cluster of network bursts (Wagenaar 2006); 1 would additionally label every single network burst longer than the duration floor a superburst.

filtering._comment: Driver only. reference_file = Excel with 'Run #' and 'Assay' columns.

plotting._comment: plot_mode: separate | merged. raster_sort: none | firing_rate | location_y | unit_id. fixed_y: use fixed y-axis limits (run once without it first).

curation._comment: Set no_curation to true to skip unit filtering entirely.

quality_thresholds._comment: amplitude_median is compared in absolute value (uV): units whose median spike amplitude is smaller in magnitude than this are rejected, whichever sign convention the installed SpikeInterface reports. Per-rule rejection counts are written to curation_summary.json; compare them across genotypes before trusting group statistics, since presence_ratio in particular removes burst-only units and therefore hits hypoactive wells hardest.
